thread:
Priya: FYI just finished an intro call with NordBank. They want a short POC (3 weeks) that proves EU-only residency, BYOK, and no control-plane telemetry leaving EU. Asked for exact subprocessors and whether our connector agent sends metadata to non-EU hosts.

Sam: Quick take: Private VPC or on-prem connector can keep inference traffic in eu-west-1. BYOK supported for Private deployments. Control-plane management usually goes to our central control plane unless customer runs fully offline air-gap. We have a "signaling-only" connector mode that minimizes metadata; needs SOW.

Laila: Customer explicitly said "no telemetry outside EU" — they will not accept control-plane ops in US. Can we offer a managed Private with EU control plane?

Tom_ops: We have an EU control-plane option for enterprise Private (runs in eu-west-1), but it's limited to customers on the Private enterprise tier and requires a deployment window + support SLA. For POC we can provision a temporary EU control-plane node but need Legal to approve data flow.

Priya: Can someone post the subprocessor snapshot (EU-only) they might touch metadata during POC? NordBank will want names and contact points for each subproc.

Sam: I'll upload the EU subprocessor list. Short summary: connector maintainer (Ops team), cloud infra provider for customer VPC (customer-controlled), optional metrics exporter (third-party) only if explicitly enabled. No CDN/logging subprocs in the Private on-prem flow.

infra_bot: Automated note: current recommended routing modes: "PIN_ONLY" (reject outside region), "AFFINITY" (prefer region, allow spill), "GLOBAL" (failover allowed). Example config for strict residency:

```
routing:
  mode: PIN_ONLY
  region: eu-west-1
  failover_allowed: false
  kv_cache_scope: regional
```

Sam: Also clarify connector modes:
- standard: heartbeat + minimal metrics + rollout check-ins
- signaling-only: license/rollout handshake only, no logs/metrics shipped
- air-gapped: no control-plane; requires offline license and local-only management (SOW + on-site ops)

Laila: Pricing question: NordBank asked ballpark delta vs hosted for PIN_ONLY + BYOK + EU control-plane for a 3-week POC (2 reserved A10g equiv GPUs). Any quick numbers?

Tom_ops: Very rough: POC compute reservation + connector ops + EU control-plane slice = ~3-5x per-token cost vs hosted. If they want our on-prem air-gapped SOW add fixed engineering day rates (~80h) + travel if on-site. I'll draft a short matrix.

legal_bot: Security note: Need BYOK proof (KMS ARNs in EU), completed Vendor Security Questionnaire section 4 (Data Residency), and signed DPA with EU residency addendum before processing any customer PII. If they insist control plane stays in EU, update DPA and routing annex.

Priya: I'll send the questionnaire link and ask for KMS ARN. Also will confirm whether they require SIGNALING_ONLY or full EU control plane.

Sam: Action items: 1) Sam to post EU subprocessor export here (done) 2) Tom to draft pricing matrix + SOW sketch 3) Priya to share questionnaire + collect KMS ARN and preference for connector mode 4) Legal to review DPA variant if EU control plane requested.

Sam: Presales ticket created: https://redwood.example.com/tickets/PR-8421
